entries.text: Hi, it's Sarah from HeliumDeploy. Thanks for taking a few minutes with me: your code, 10% off, shows up on screen as soon as we finish. I see you were looking at the Bugatti Gatsby Carry-On. What caught your eye?
It's for a two week trip to Portugal with my wife in November. We fly Air Transat.
A two-week Portugal trip with your wife sounds lovely, and November is a nice time to go. Since you're flying Air Transat, is carry-on size what matters most to you in choosing a bag?
Mostly it has to fit the carry on size limit. And be light. I really hate heavy bags.
Totally fair, nobody likes lugging a heavy bag through an airport. The product page has the exact weight and dimensions. What other bags or stores are you comparing this one with?
I looked at Samsonite on Amazon and something at Costco. But the Bugatti looks nicer.
Good to hear the Bugatti looks nicer to you. Style matters on a trip like that. What would make you buy it today, or what's holding you back?
Honestly, I just want to know the exact dimensions. And if shipping is fast enough before the trip,
I don't have the exact dimensions myself, so I'll point to them on the page. Delivery times aren't in what I have either, and the shipping policy page covers them.
One thing I can tell you: the shipping policy says HeliumDeploy is responsible for the order until it reaches your door. With a November flight, how much time do you have before you leave?
I saw an Instagram ad a few days ago. That's how I found you.
Good to know, an Instagram ad a few days ago. Thanks for sharing all of this. Your code will appear on screen as soon as you press "End call". Enjoy Portugal, and goodbye!
Sorry, one more thing before you go. You said you really hate heavy bags. Is there a weight you'd want to stay under for this trip?
